name: 旧钥匙串
description: 齿口各不相同的旧钥匙挤在一起，已经没人记得它们曾打开哪扇门。
subject: Three worn iron and brass house keys attached to one simple rusty keyring.

name: 木工刨子
description: 木柄被掌心磨得发亮，刨口还留着一缕卷起的木屑。
subject: Traditional wooden carpenter hand plane, honey wood rectangular body, dark iron blade, cross handle.

name: 缝纫盒
description: 针线、布片和顶针各归其位，细细补好日子里的每一道裂缝。
subject: Open small wooden sewing box containing chunky thread spools, folded cloth, scissors and pincushion; one cohesive object.

name: 修补过的布偶
description: 补丁盖住了旧伤，歪歪的针脚把许多年的陪伴缝在一起。
subject: Small seated brown cloth teddy bear, mismatched button eyes, cream stitched patch, floppy limbs, lovingly repaired.

name: 封蜡印章
description: 印头落进温热的封蜡，留下一个只属于寄信人的记号。
subject: One antique wax seal stamp lying diagonally, turned walnut handle and round engraved brass seal face visible.

name: 机械怀表
description: 掀开表盖，细小的齿轮依然替往昔守着时间。
subject: Round brass mechanical pocket watch open cover, cream dial with simple hour ticks no numbers, short attached chain.

name: 发条音乐盒
description: 拧动发条，黄铜音筒便把一段老旋律慢慢唱完。
subject: Open modest walnut wind-up music box showing brass pinned cylinder and metal comb, small side winding key, no bird.

name: 航海六分仪
description: 弧上的刻度连接海平线与星辰，带远行的人找到归途。
subject: Antique brass nautical sextant, recognizable triangular arc graduated rim, small telescope and walnut grip.

name: 虎符
description: 卧虎形的青铜凭证，只有两半相合，才可传达调兵之令。
subject: Ancient Chinese bronze tiger military tally, low crouching tiger elongated body, small head, curled tail, seam dividing two halves, green patina, no writing.

name: 昆虫琥珀
description: 金色树脂封住一只小虫，也封住了一个遥远的午后。
subject: Single irregular polished golden amber nugget containing one clearly visible tiny dark prehistoric insect.

name: 魔豆
description: 几粒不起眼的绿豆，似乎正等待一场通往云端的雨。
subject: Three large magical emerald beans as one compact cluster, one bean sprouting a short curled shoot, no soil or pot.

name: 魔镜
description: 镜面深处浮动着陌生的轮廓，它知道的秘密比倒影更多。
subject: Standing oval enchanted mirror, carved dark purple and antique gold frame, silver blue reflective glass with subtle mysterious face within glass, compact pedestal.

name: 月老红线
description: 红线绕过漫长的岁月，另一端系着尚未相逢的人。
subject: One vivid crimson silk cord loosely wound into a compact loop with a traditional Chinese knotted center and two short red tassels, no stand.

name: 金箍棒
description: 两端金箍锁住赤铁，长短变化只在主人一念之间。
subject: One Ruyi Jingu Bang staff diagonally from lower left to upper right, long dark red iron shaft, broad ornate gold bands at both ends, no writing.

name: 雷神之锤
description: 短柄承起沉重的铁锤，古老的雷声藏在锤面的纹路里。
subject: Norse myth Mjolnir, squat blocky weathered iron hammer head with restrained geometric knot engraving, short leather wrapped handle and loop, no superhero franchise motifs.

name: 如意宝珠
description: 珠光随心愿流转，掌中小小的圆满仿佛盛得下万千可能。
subject: One luminous round pearl-like wish jewel in a small lotus-shaped antique golden holder, iridescent cyan pink inner reflections contained inside orb, no external aura.

name: 阿拉丁神灯
description: 拭去灯身尘埃，长嘴金灯仍静静等着下一个愿望。
subject: Classic Aladdin Arabian brass oil lamp, low round body, long upturned spout, curved loop handle, domed lid, restrained turquoise inlay, no genie or smoke.

name: 爱疯18
subject: 爱情公寓的夸张超长手机；机身长宽比9:1，圆形实体Home键。

name: 钻石剑
description: 青蓝色像素拼成锋刃，方块世界里的冒险从未结束。
subject: Minecraft钻石剑，保留青蓝阶梯像素轮廓和棕色剑柄。
